description: The main window: Tauri's core; closing itself (window.destroy) once the webview's close handler has let it (CloseGuard); the system's open dialog, its narrowest permission, which the window shows only as a folder dialog to pick the project folder (ProjectBar), and none of the dialog plugin's save, message or ask dialogs; and the app's own commands, server and open_outside (an https page or a bundled license file), which every window may call since build.rs lists none
